description: Account balance, month-to-date usage and this account's own per-operation prices. Free: this call never spends credits. balance_usd is the wallet; grants_usd is bonus and plan credit (sign-up bonus, perks, plan allowance), reported apart. Grants are spent first, but only on the operations each one covers: a promo perk or a plan allowance may not pay for API calls, and a perk never pays for phone numbers, so the two figures do not add up to what the account can spend. Useful before a batch of paid work (what the user can afford) and after it (what was spent). These are the account's real rates; prices in tool descriptions are list prices.

include_prices.description: Include this account's per-operation prices. Default true.

include_token_analytics.description: Also return per-API-token request counts for the last 30 days (by endpoint and status). Free. Useful for answering "which integration is making these calls?".

include_transactions.description: Also return the N most recent transactions (each shows the operation type and dollar amount).

include_usage.description: Also return the month-to-date credit usage broken down by operation type. Free.

name: get_balance
title: Balance, usage and your prices (free)
